title: Webel
summary: A home-services marketplace in production, with thousands of users. I'm the web lead: internal dashboard, company profile (a meaningful share of GMV), marketplace and the Next.js migration.
problem: Hiring professional services (home improvements, lessons, care, events) is still opaque: comparing options is hard, pricing is unclear and coordinating schedules turns into endless message threads.
audience: People who need a service, professionals offering their work, and companies managing services for their teams.
role: Frontend tech lead: React and TypeScript across several critical products, growing the web team and pushing AI into the development workflow.
responsibilities: Development and evolution of the marketplace frontend: search, service pages, booking and tracking.
Webel Business, the B2B product, with its own flows and permissions.
The internal dashboard the team runs operations with.
High-impact flows: verification and the payment migration from Mangopay to Stripe.
Migrating the main web app to Next.js and programmatic SEO with Astro.
Mentoring two mid-senior developers and building context architecture for Cursor and Claude Code.
decisions: Shared components across products so each new one costs less than the last.
Performance and technical SEO treated as product requirements, not maintenance chores.
AI in the team's development flow: skills, docs and context that actually help — not demos.
outcomes: A live platform in production with several active product fronts.
A web team that can own a good chunk of day-to-day work.
Critical flows (payments, verification, B2B) delivered alongside backend, iOS and Android.
